messages:
mira: FYI AcmeLedger wants a 2-week POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls -> newline JSON lines to their on-prem collector. They insist on customer-managed KMS (HSM) + SOC2 excerpts. Any quick no-go items?

alex: No protocol blockers. SDKs support streaming + function_calls. Main snag is their reverse proxy strips Authorization; options: mTLS endpoint between their proxy and our Private ingress, or ephemeral signed URLs.

judy: Cost heads-up: they estimated 10-20 qps, ~100 tokens in / ~500 tokens out. I'll draft on-demand vs 6/12mo reserved scenarios.

prashant: For strict JSON-lines use structured-output + runtime schema validation. Prompt suffix: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys: id, verdict, score. No extra text."

sec-bot: SOC2 bundle available; KMS via KMIP/cloud KMS supported. HSM attestation depends on vendor but we can accept vendor-signed attestation. Compliance ticket created: INC-9981 (ETA 48h).

mira: Action list: Judy pricing by EOD, Alex scope mTLS vs signed-URL effort, Sec to post packet. I'll schedule kickoff for next Tue.
